baseline.method: Initial repository metadata provides manifests and test configuration but no ranked source candidates.

candidate.method: Rank bounded source reads using issue terms, file paths, and declared symbols.

decision: Retain behind a disabled-by-default feature flag until real-model paired runs establish end-to-end benefit.
limitations: This measures relevant-file recall, not task solve rate.
The six repositories are small, so the result does not establish performance on large repositories.
Held-out tasks and their solution patches were excluded from this comparison.
No token, runtime, or regression improvement is claimed without organizer model runs.
